			<section class="section-info" id="js-content">
				<div class="shell">
					<div class="section__inner">
						<div class="section__content">
							<div class="section__head">
								<h1 class="artwork--title">Lantern with Eight Daoist Immortals</h2>
							</div><!-- /.section__head -->

							<div class="section__body">
								<div class="section__entry">
                                    
                                    									
                                    <div class="section__author">
										<a href="https://art.thewalters.org/browse/creator/chinese/">Chinese</a>
                                        (Artist)									</div><!-- /.section__author -->

                                    
									<div class="section__date">1662-1722 (Qing dynasty (1644-1911))</div>

									<div class="section__category">Porcelain,overglaze enamel<br> <a href="https://art.thewalters.org/browse/category/china/">(China                                                                                                                    )</a></div><!-- /.section__category -->
								</div><!-- /.section__entry -->

								<p>In China, the Eight Immortals are among the most popular figures in Daoism, a school of thought that grounds human behavior in cycles of nature. Here, each immortal exercises their unique powers to cross the sea. </p>

                                
                                
								<h3 class="section__subtitle">
									Provenance
									<strong>
										<div class="tooltip tooltip--alt js-tooltip">
											<div class="tooltip__trigger">
												<em class="ico-tooltip">
													<svg>
														<use xlink:href="#ico-tooltip"></use>
													</svg>
												</em>
											</div><!-- /.tooltip__trigger -->

											<div class="tooltip__inner">
												Provenance (from the French <em lang="fr">provenir</em>, 'to come from/forth') is the chronology of the ownership, custody, or location of a historical object. Learn more about <a href="https://thewalters.org/art-research/#provenance" target="_blank">provenance at the Walters</a>.											</div><!-- /.tooltip__inner -->
										</div><!-- /.tooltip -->
									</strong>
								</h3>

								<p>William T. Walters, Baltimore; inherited by Henry Walters; by bequest to Walters Art Museum, 1931.</p>

                                
                                
                                
								<div class="section__table">
									<h3 class="section__subtitle">Conservation</h3>
									<div class="table table--alt">
										<table>
											<colgroup>
												<col class="table__col--size1">
												<col class="table__col--size2">
												<col class="table__col--size3">
											</colgroup>
											<tr>
												<th>Date</th>
												<th>Description</th>
												<th>Narrative</th>
											</tr>
                                            											<tr>
												<td>10/14/2016</td>
												<td>Treatment</td>
												<td>examined for exhibition</td>
											</tr>
                                            											<tr>
												<td>10/14/2016</td>
												<td>Treatment</td>
												<td>The lantern was broken into 212 fragments in 1934.  The lantern was important to William T.  Walter&#039;s collection of Chinese porcelain.  The lantern was reassembled using an acrylic adhesive.  Losses were filled and inpainted for installation in #1 West Mount Vernon Place&#039;s exhibition of ceramics in 2018.</td>
											</tr>
                                            										</table>
									</div><!-- /.table -->
								</div><!-- /.section__table -->

                                
							</div><!-- /.section__body -->
						</div><!-- /.section__content -->

<script>
const $searchParams = new URLSearchParams( window.location.search );

const $utm_params = [
    'utm_campaign',
    'utm_source',
    'utm_medium',
    'utm_term',
    'utm_content',
    'utm_id',
    'utm_target',
    'utm_creative',
    'utm_device',
    'utm_adposition',
    'partner_id',
    'partner_subid',
    'product',
    'msclkid'
];

const _domainroot = window.location.hostname;
console.log( _domainroot );

let $utmQuery = new URLSearchParams( '' );

$utm_params.forEach(function( value ){
    if ( $searchParams.get( value ) )
    {
        $utmQuery.append( value, $searchParams.get( value ) );
    }
});

let totutmvars = $utmQuery.toString();

jQuery( document ).ready(function($){
    if ( totutmvars != '' ) 
    {
        $( 'a' ).each(function(){
            let url = $(this).attr( 'href' );
            let modify_url = false;
    
            // fix bug with missing href attributes on certain URLs
            if ( typeof url == 'undefined' ) return;
    
            if ( url.indexOf( _domainroot ) != -1 )
                modify_url = true;
    
            if ( url.substring( 0, 1 ) == '/' )
                modify_url = true;
    
            if ( modify_url )
            {
                if ( url.indexOf( '?' ) == -1 )
                    $( this ).attr( 'href', url + '?' + totutmvars );
                else
                    $( this ).attr( 'href', url + '&' + totutmvars );
            }
        });
    }

});
</script>
